proposal: The Mandate recommends moving the Renewable Fuel Standard program out of the Office of Transportation and Air Quality into its own suboffice in Washington, with status parallel to that office and the stationary-source office and headed by a political appointee, and establishing a memorandum of understanding with the Department of Agriculture and the Department of Energy to work together on the program (p. 428).
